title: May a docs-only review record follow an earlier review round on the same PR?
why: Lane fix-verifier-stands-for-round-2 found case (c): a review record that is docs-only after an earlier round. Decision pr-review-record line 54 refuses a lower top round, and decision docs-only-prs-skip-review says a review record is never docs-only. No owner ruling covers it (triage read 08:33 CST Nov 13).
note: Needs an owner item before any build: the lane sends triage the question-form lines (goal, problem, based-on, departs-from, gain and lose per option). Triage posts the item. No lane until the owner answers. 08:35 CST Nov 13: Cockpit item 686 posted, from the lane's question-form lines. The page's question judge marked option a (allow) as widening the shared review-record check, so b (keep the refusal) is the recommended option. The lane's test-author red check is commit a44ae8162 on the lane's local branch fix-verifier-r2-record (not pushed).
